exposure: Occlusion balloon catheter placement during cesarean
placement of an occlusion balloon catheter in the internal iliac artery
cohort: Women with placenta previa and suspected placenta accreta spectrum undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: The use of an occlusion balloon catheter in patients with placenta previa and suspected placenta accreta spectrum undergoing cesarean delivery did not significantly reduce intraoperative blood loss or transfusions but was associated with a higher hysterectomy rate.
